principles: no bookmaker price is read anywhere
every input is a number returned by an official payload
no value is filled when the payload is silent
prices are fair odds derived from our own probability, with no margin added
window_test: price between -250 and +10,000 inclusive, evaluated on the price we quote

nhl.distribution: independent Poisson goals per side over 60 minutes plus overtime, scored up to 16 goals
nhl.attack: shrunken goals-for rate / league average, prior 8 games
nhl.defence: shrunken goals-against rate / league average, prior 8 games
nhl.home_edge: 1.06 on the home lambda, 0.94 on the away lambda
nhl.draw_handling: half of the regulation draw is credited to each side

mlb.attack: shrunken runs-scored rate / league average, prior 40 games
mlb.defence: shrunken runs-allowed rate / league average, prior 40 games
mlb.home_edge: 1.02 on the home lambda, 0.98 on the away lambda
mlb.draw_handling: half of the tie is credited to each side (extra innings)

lol.map_probability: Bradley-Terry style ratio of smoothed series win rates, prior 1.5 wins and 1.5 losses per side
lol.series: independent and identical maps, exact best-of-n distribution
lol.unpriced: series with no record for at least one team carry no price
